711510802.text: Let's see... Not bad, pretty standard shot. If you look at it from the neck up, it could even pass for a mugshot.

711510803.text: I'll be keeping this, really appreciate the help.

711510804.text: Not bad at all, flew high and burned bright. Makes me wanna buy a few to bring back to the Fortress.

711510805.text: Then again... Xiao Lanterns released in the Fortress of Meropide wouldn't fly to the sky or grant wishes. They'd just mean more work for the janitorial crew.

711510807.text: Oh, and to you too. I'll still need to buy some gifts later... uh, other than tea.
